candidates.description: This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments commonly found in historical, fantasy, and cultural proper nouns or related vocabulary.
This feature vector activates on Spanish indefinite determiners and quantifiers indicating quantity or variation.
This feature vector activates common roots and morphological prefixes shared across multiple languages.
Common Spanish auxiliary and conjugated verbs expressing states, actions, and tenses.
This feature activates on words and subwords related to religion, theology, and sacred or biblical concepts.
This feature vector represents modal verbs and concepts of possibility, capability, or obligation, particularly in Spanish and English.
This feature vector represents the concept of quantity, degree, or extent across different languages.
This feature vector represents the concept of fear and horror, encompassing related genres, emotional states, and terms across multiple languages.
These tokens represent Spanish and Portuguese prepositions indicating spatial, temporal, or logical relationships.
This vector represents plural and singular nouns denoting people, entities, and tangible objects in Spanish.
